title: Research: exact two-relation four-register pattern census and scoped obstruction
body:
## Contribution

This package records a finite exact census and a scoped negative result for a four-register rational frame with exactly two independent address relations. It evaluates the proposed first-seven-prefix construction class; it does not establish an obstruction for arbitrary words or supply a new kappa.

The exact census enumerates all 120 rank-one idempotents in M4(F2), 105 off-diagonal patterns (including zero), and 196 realizable two-dimensional pattern planes. Of the planes, 176 admit a common topological order and 20 have cyclic union. The candidate screen checks all 20 exceptional planes under all six relation-signature bijections and finds no diagonal singleton endpoint. The exact 16-call positive control passes; a one-call deletion and an address corruption are rejected.

## Reproduction

```sh
python3 -I -B research/two-relation-pattern-census-seed52/verify.py
python3 scripts/research_package.py --package research/two-relation-pattern-census-seed52 --check-only
python3 -B scripts/research_baseline.py
```

Expected markers include `PASS_TWO_RELATION_PATTERN_CENSUS`, `PASS_PACKAGE_METADATA_AND_PINS`, and `PASS_RESEARCH_BASELINE_BINDINGS_ONLY`. The baseline confirms that the complex supplier still binds the selected conditional kappa; this scoped screen gives no kappa improvement.

The searched family, full stopping rule, proof-relevant certificate, negative controls, exact source pins, overlap evidence, attribution, and open follow-up questions are included in the package README and task metadata. Prepared with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance; no independent human review is claimed.
